poles.remarks: Rows A and C match the 480 in design length; row B is 11 in short (B0 / B4 inside the line of the other rows - the drone sees B0 at x ~10 in and B4 at x ~476 in; the operator does not remember why).

body_footprint.source: repo design size, confirmed by the operator as measured

HOUSE_2.remarks: roof slopes read off the photo as 61.5 / 61.2 from the wrong end of a 1 m rule (operator) -> 100 - x; back_left eave unreadable on the photo (operator does not remember).

ground_tilt_vs_gravity.source: drone model 2026-10-02_all model 1 (647 frames): the gimbal holds roll level, so each frame's image-right axis is horizontal; fitted in the anchored paddock frame with a constant gimbal roll offset (+0.17 deg)
ground_tilt_vs_gravity.meaning: the paddock floor plane rises ~18 cm from the west (x 0) to the east end over 40 ft and ~21 cm from row A (y 0) to row C over 20 ft; confirmed by the operator (west low, east high; row C side high). The calibration frame is the ground plane itself, so the tilt does not enter the mapping; it matters only against gravity (a plumb line from a camera lands 3-8 cm downhill).
